text_block_list.text:

Sasabari than right now!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Wanna try a sample pressure point 
strike? Just a gentle one, suuuper gentle.

text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can do my absolute best work 
right now! Isn't that great?! It's totally 
fine, right? Then it's settled!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Alright~ I'm gonna poke and prod all day~☆
